nodes.description: Source and first lifetime-materialization step. After skipping the leading comment line, `node_from_openstep()` parses the next quoted token as a standalone `PLIST_STRING` and stores the resulting heap node in `*plist`.

Root cause. The fallback-to-'strings' branch invalidates the initial parsed node before storing any replacement or nulling the out-parameter, so `*plist` becomes a dangling alias if the retry parse later fails.
AddressSanitizer crash site. The second `plist_free()` enters `plist_free_node()` with the dangling `node_t *`, and evaluating `node->parent` for `node_detach()` reads the freed object.
